name: Get Outta My Gut
description:
About This Game

The infection got in. You are what's left of the defense

Your internal ecosystem is under siege from mutated pathogens, parasitic swarms, and toxic bacteria. Forget predictable lanes and polite waves. In "Get Outta My Gut", the infection gathers behind a white membrane, pooling into massive, writhing swarms while you fortify your defenses.

Your job: make sure none of it reaches the heart.

Draft your arsenal

Draft Turret Cards throughout your run each rolling with randomized rarities from Common to Legendary to fuel your ultimate anti-germ defense.

Fight the swarm, not the lane

Hundreds of pathogens surge across open tissue like a raging river. Wall them off, redirect their flow, and build biological dams, turret placement isn’t just slot-filling, it’s visceral terrain engineering. Watch the horde split helplessly around your killzone and dissolve under a barrage of caustic goo, kinetic sparks, and bio-electric lightning.

Upgrade trees that change everything

Every single turret features a deep mutation tree crowned with game-changing capstones. Mutate standard bullets into homing seeker swarms, fire surgical beams that vivisect weakened pathogens, shatter frozen hordes with cryo-bursts, or deploy germ crushing turrets that devour the dead to replenish your host's heart.

An economy with teeth

Maximize your bio-economy through lethal kill bounties, end-of-wave payouts, cellular interest on unspent reserves, and a roaring combo meter that rewards nonstop slaughter. Every wave is a high-speed optimization puzzle and S-Ranks are ripped from the horde, not handed out.

Die, Evolve, Go deeper

Every run won or lost is harvested into stem cells, spent on a permanent Evolution tree: thicker heart lining, richer metabolism, faster antibodies, draft rerolls, and turrets that must be grown before they ever appear in your drafts. The body remembers. Next run, you're stronger.

10 organs and hundreds of waves

Fight through the body with organs in different difficulty, from a fair fight to an always-mutated nightmare.

  • Fight massive hordes of Germs

  • Strategically cut the Membranes to control the intruders.

  • Multiple turret classes with unique per-turret upgrade trees

    Card drafts with 5 rarities and meta-unlockable weapons

  • Combo, rank, streak and interest systems that reward skillful play

  • Persistent Evolution tree every death makes the next run stronger

  • 10 organs, 100 waves, wave mutators, elites, bosses
short_desc: A rogue-lite tower defense where you control the horde. Draft randomized bio-turret cards, reshape tissue into lethal killzones, and manually slice open pathogen sacs to unleash fluid swarms on your terms. Evolve across 10 organs, don't let the contagion reach the heart.
